fields.name: no
fields.note: wish number text, empty until paid/sealed (lib/account.ts:12)

filtersOrSort: by id from URL ?id=; status in draft|sealed only (others redirect to /app/wishes/<id>)

reads.note: Browser-local today (localStorage 'fw-maker', lib/maker.ts:28-32). Wish has no place for these; server must either add fields (wedding day, opens-now flag, voice seconds) or keep them as draft metadata. 'now' is derived into opensAt at seal.

fields.name: opens
fields.note: text such as 'When you send' / 'Midnight on the day'; sentNow() tests /when you send/i

reads.note: lib/catalog category(kind).occasions, static in code; recipe(kind,occasion).opens.time default time, defaultOpeningValues(...,'sealed').at fixed date. FIXED holiday map in lib/maker.ts:73 (valentines 14 Feb, christmas 25 Dec, new-year 1 Jan, end-of-year 31 Dec)

actions.name: saveDraft

payload.name: patch
payload.type: Partial<Wish> (whole Wish object is written today via saveWish/putWish, lib/maker.ts:40-46)

actions.note: Fired on every change: typing is debounced 300ms (Maker.tsx:65), choices save immediately (set(...,true)); also on pagehide/visibilitychange. Returns false (UI shows 'Not saved: no room left') when localStorage full.

actions.name: setOpensAt

payload.name: opensAt
payload.type: string ISO-8601 from local date+time via new Date(`${day}T${time}:00`).toISOString() (browser's own time zone, no zone sent)

actions.note: conventions need instant + receiver IANA zone; the code sends neither the zone nor a receiver zone

actions.name: setOpensNow
actions.note: 'As soon as it is sealed' toggle; at seal opensAt becomes new Date().toISOString() (client clock)

rolesObserved: person (owner of the wish); business side when account.pro and (space=='business' or kind teams|photographers)
authContext.note: Maker.tsx:181 renders a blank busy shell if no account; no redirect inside the maker.

uiStatesHandled.note: account and draft come from synchronous localStorage read in an effect; one frame at most. With a server read it becomes real and needs the app skeleton.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: ?id= names a wish not in account.wishes or status 'removed' (setMissing, Maker.tsx:90,182-189): 'That wish is not here.'
uiStatesHandled.note: deleted, or made on another device (copy says so; with a server the other-device case disappears)

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: saveWish returns false (localStorage quota) -> header text 'Not saved: no room left', Maker.tsx:57,439
uiStatesHandled.note: device-storage error; server equivalent is a failed save with retry. No retry control coded.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: none coded (no network calls on this screen)
not applicable: a draft always has screens
wish, screen and play all present
!note.now && opensAt < Date.now(): 'That time has passed. Choose a later one.' Continue disabled (whenReady)
canNow false (sealed rule, not sent-now, not teams/photographers): only the day/time pickers show
wedding day set (marks before/after) or fixed occasion date >= today

stubsObserved.evidence: /* A draft is a Wish in the account, saved on every step */ saveWish writes whole account JSON to localStorage 'fw-account'
stubsObserved.consequence: drafts exist only in this browser; ?id= link fails on another device (the 'missing' state)

stubsObserved.standsInFor: server storage of wedding day / opens-now / voice seconds
stubsObserved.consequence: values lost on another device; wedding day and 'now' have no field on Wish

stubsObserved.evidence: new Date(iso).getTime() <= Date.now()+60000 -> 'as soon as it is sealed'; whenReady compares to Date.now()
stubsObserved.standsInFor: server clock for 'is this time in the future'
stubsObserved.consequence: phone clock is trusted for validation; server must re-validate opensAt > now and own the opening moment (conventions)
